defect: the input clock is redefined under a second clock name
rationale: clk_i has one physical waveform and should have one primary clock definition. The second definition creates a duplicate clock object on the same port and makes the gated-clock timing relationship ambiguous.

mutation.description: Added a second create_clock with a different name on the existing clk_i port.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the enable register, gated-clock expression, and gated-clock consumer; reduced the synchronizer and removed reset and primitive-cell boundaries.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: A second clock is created on clk_i without -add, redefining the clock that feeds the gate.
